text: Art Spiegelman's Maus was removed from McMinn County Schools by a vote of the McMinn Board of Education, which cited what it described as unnecessary profanity and nudity and depictions of violence and suicide. In Moscow, Biblio Globus, Moskva, and Moskovsky Dom Knigi removed Maus from their shelves and Internet stores. Russian bookstore chains pulled it in April 2015, days before the 70th anniversary of the Soviet WWII victory, after retailers cited a 2014 Russian law restricting Nazi symbols in public display; the swastika on the cover was the explicit trigger, and the author publicly criticised the removal. District employees flagged Maus for review by the Nixa, Missouri, school board, which voted to keep it on shelves.
meta_description: Maus by Art Spiegelman: removed by the McMinn Board of Education; pulled from Moscow bookstores in April 2015; kept by the Nixa, Missouri school board.
